brief: A resort-town house in Petoskey: I.N. Debenham's house, as photographed — see the photo for its massing and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: Petoskey's resort-town streets (the town's model) were built 1880-1930, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Debenham House (Petoskey, 1900): a Queen Anne in grey clapboard with shingled gables and round vents, a recessed upper balcony porch, a wrap porch with a spindle frieze, a bay; on a corner lot raised behind segmental-block retaining walls with steps; a crabapple in bloom; a for-sale sign

why.note: hillside lots terraced with block walls (modern replacement of stone)
